text: Pasifik is a privately held Turkish investment group that grew from Orçay A.Ş., founded in 1986, into 55 companies active in real estate, logistics, technology, energy and mining, four of them traded on BIST; its chairman is Fatih Erdoğan. Neither pasifik.com nor press coverage identifies a state or fund shareholder.
short: Pasifik Holding is a private Erdoğan-family Turkish investment group (55 companies).
